children: Myseum.AI intends to apply to tokenize its Nasdaq-listed common stock through one or more qualified digital-asset securities platforms.
Filed Form 8-K disclosing intent to apply for an issuer-authorized tokenized representation of common stock.
Tokenized shares would represent actual registered Myseum.AI common stock and preserve economic and voting rights.
Tokenization could enable blockchain-based ownership records, more efficient settlement, and expanded access on digital platforms.
Any tokenization is conditional on provider acceptance, regulatory and exchange requirements, and negotiation of definitive agreements.
